source: configs/lam_audio2exp_config_streaming.py at LAM sha 02a703c3ea7d8e360eb43098eca85ee98a083529, read back through the project's own Config parser in an isolated environment

entrypoint.why: librosa.load -> 1 s chunks -> infer_streaming_audio -> np.concatenate -> export_blendshape_animation. No torch.distributed launch, no renderer, no UI.
entrypoint.alternative: inference.py reaches the same model but goes through engines/launch.py, which pulls torch.distributed even for a single process.

io_contract.input_load: librosa.load(cfg.audio_input, sr=16000) — resamples whatever is on disk
io_contract.output_format: JSON via export_blendshape_animation, which raises unless shape[1] == 52
io_contract.channel_order_provenance: measured — models/utils.py ARKitBlendShape, read in the validation environment

determinism.what_happens: engines/defaults.py:115 replaces a null seed with get_random_seed(), which is os.getpid() + wall-clock microseconds + 2 bytes of os.urandom. set_seed then seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda, and sets cudnn.deterministic = True.
determinism.consequence: the network forward pass is deterministic under torch.no_grad(), but the post-processing draws from numpy's global RNG, so two runs over the same audio produce different eye-blink timing and intensity.
stochastic_sites: models/utils.py:716-749  apply_random_brow_movement — not reached, brow_movement is false
determinism.fix_for_L1: pass --options seed=<int> (default_config_parser merges options before the null check), or set seed in the config. Not changed at L0.
determinism.affected_channels: 8 (eyeBlinkLeft) and 9 (eyeBlinkRight). jawOpen (24) is not touched by any random path.

post_processing_pipeline.source: engines/infer.py:250-257, order is load-bearing per its own comment

silence_handling.action: the 29 MOUTH_BLENDSHAPES channels are multiplied by 0.1 inside detected silent regions, with a 3-frame blend at each boundary

range_and_clamping.caveat: two steps run after the clamp. symmetrize_blendshapes averages pairs, which cannot exceed the range. apply_random_eye_blinks_context writes pattern * intensity with intensity <= 1.0 into channels 8 and 9. So the effective range is [0, 1], but it is not enforced by a final clamp.

streaming_state.first_chunk: left-padded with zeros to 64 frames worth of audio
streaming_state.later_chunks: left-padded with the tail of the previous chunk's audio

known_defects_not_fixed_at_L0: engines/infer.py:206 is a bare `except:` that then references output_dict, which is unbound if the model call itself raised, and returns None instead of the (dict, context) tuple the caller unpacks. A model failure therefore surfaces as a confusing TypeError or UnboundLocalError.
engines/infer.py:200-203 calls .cuda(non_blocking=True) unconditionally, so this path cannot run on CPU without a source change.
